---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 🚀 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Motivation

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve?

## 📋 Detailed Description

Describe the feature in detail:
- What should it do?
- How should it work?
- What are the expected outcomes?

## 🎨 UI/UX (if applicable)

If this is a frontend feature, describe the UI/UX:
- What should the interface look like?
- How should users interact with it?
- Any mockups or wireframes?

## 🔧 Technical Considerations

- Does this require database changes?
- Does this require API changes?
- Any dependencies or integrations needed?
- Performance considerations?

## 📚 Related Documentation

Link to relevant documentation or related features.

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## 🔗 Related Issues

Link to any related issues.

## 📝 Additional Context

Add any other context, examples, or screenshots about the feature request here.
